conocimientos previos equivalentes a la asignatura Automatización y Control

conocimientos básicos de Matlab/Simulink (similares a los empleados en la asignatura Automatización y Control)

learning_outcomes.text: Propose control solutions for technological engineering problems
Classify control systems based on their performance, limitations, and typology in industrial problems
Design control systems using basic analysis and design techniques: root locus, frequency, and state space
Evaluate designs performed in various aspects, such as reference tracking, control action, disturbance rejection, robustness, or relative stability
Recognize the most important practical aspects and limitations derived from the implementation and use of technology in the control implementation phase

syllabus_topics: Feedback loop analysis: sensitivity and stability
Tuning of proportional controller by classic methods
Tuning of integral action by classic methods
Tuning of differential action by classic methods
State feedback. Advantages of state space.
Digital implementation of controllers: discretization of controllers
Exercises with laboratory equipment and in simulation, covering system identification, sensitivity, controller design, digital control, and state space.
assessment_rules: For the ordinary call, a minimum grade of 4 out of 10 is required in the theoretical block. The practical part is calculated as P = 0.9 PL + 0.1 PA. The final grade is calculated as N = 0.7 T + 0.3 P. If the minimum theoretical grade is not met, the final grade will be the minimum of the calculated grade and 4.0. For the extraordinary call, there is a single theoretical exam; the practical grade from the teaching period is maintained, or P=0 if practices were not done. The final grade for the extraordinary call is N = 0.7 T + 0.3 P, with a minimum of 4 points in the theoretical exam required to pass. For differentiated evaluation, students can take an additional practical exam, where P = practical exam grade.
